name: Summerchase Condominium Association
description: The Summerchase Condominium was built in 1986. An empty and unsettled Highway 182 (later renamed Perdido Beach Boulevard) welcomed the "new" construction. The fourteen story building changed the sky line of Orange Beach. Additional construction continued in the "little fishing town" until only a few local residents and historians recalled the history of the area. Locals nicknamed the building "A Grand Old Lady." Our Summerchase continues to stand tall having conquered terrible storms and challenging economic condition. Our heritage of providing fabulous family memories of great beach experiences continues. Summerchase is situated in beautiful Orange Beach, Alabama. Summerchase offers gorgeous views of the Gulf of Mexico and white sand beaches. Enjoy the beautiful views of sunrise, sunsets, and dolphins playing from your balcony. Vision Statement: Drawing upon its rich history as a high quality, family oriented condominium; Summerchase will develop and implement a proactive, strategic program which will position itself as a "premier condominium" on the Gulf Coast. Mission Statement: Our objective is to provide a facility where owners and their guests can visit anytime and always have an enjoyable experience! (After all, this is a beach vacation resort).
